title: The Science Fair
description: Four recordings about a school science fair: choosing a project, a phone call, a message and the prize-giving.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Choosing a project
parts.intro: You will hear two students, Khoa and Emma, talking about the science fair.

script.speaker: Emma
script.text: Khoa, have you decided what to do for the science fair?

script.speaker: Khoa
script.text: Well, first I wanted to build a volcano, but everybody does that. So I'm going to grow beans in different places.

script.speaker: Emma
script.text: That sounds interesting. What will you find out?

script.speaker: Khoa
script.text: I'll put one bean plant in the dark cupboard and one by the window. Then I'll see which one grows taller.

script.speaker: Emma
script.text: I think the plant in the sun will win. My project is about magnets. I'll show which things they pick up.

script.speaker: Khoa
script.text: Cool! Do you need any help?

script.speaker: Emma
script.text: Yes, can you lend me your big magnet? Mine is too small.

script.speaker: Khoa
script.text: Sure. I'll bring it on Monday. The fair is on Thursday, isn't it?

script.speaker: Emma
script.text: No, it's on Friday now. Mr Reed changed the day.

parts.title: Part 2 · Asking for help
parts.intro: You will hear Mr Reed talking to a girl, Chi, about her project.

script.speaker: Mr Reed
script.text: Chi, come in. How is your project going?

script.speaker: Chi
script.text: Not very well, Mr Reed. I'm making a small water filter from sand and stones, but the water is still dirty.

script.speaker: Mr Reed
script.text: Hmm. What did you put at the bottom of the bottle?

script.speaker: Chi
script.text: Big stones first, then sand, and some cotton at the top.

script.speaker: Mr Reed
script.text: Try putting the cotton at the bottom and the stones at the top. Also use clean sand, not sand from the garden.

script.speaker: Chi
script.text: Oh, I didn't think of that! Can I borrow some clean sand from the lab?

script.speaker: Mr Reed
script.text: Of course. Ask Mrs Kim, because she has the key. And you need to write a short report for the fair, about one page.

script.speaker: Chi
script.text: I'll write it this weekend. Thank you for your help!

parts.title: Part 3 · A message about the fair
parts.intro: You will hear a message from Emma's mum about the science fair.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Hello, Emma. It's Mum. I'm sorry, but I can't pick you up at four o'clock today.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: I have to go to the dentist, so Dad will collect you at half past four instead. Wait for him at the school gate.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: About the fair on Friday, I'm very proud of you. Dad and I will both come, and Grandma wants to come too.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Don't forget your white coat for the experiment. It's in the washing machine, but it'll be dry by tonight.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: I'll make your favourite pasta for dinner. See you later, love!

parts.title: Part 4 · Prize-giving
parts.intro: You will hear a teacher, Mrs Hart, announcing the winners of the science fair.

script.speaker: Mrs Hart
script.text: Welcome, everyone, to the end of our science fair. There were thirty projects this year, and they were all excellent.

script.speaker: Mrs Hart
script.text: The third prize goes to Tom for his electric car. It travelled two metres without anyone pushing it. Well done, Tom!

script.speaker: Mrs Hart
script.text: The second prize goes to Chi for her water filter. It was difficult to make, but she changed her idea and made it work.

script.speaker: Mrs Hart
script.text: And now, the winner. The judges say the first prize goes to Khoa and his bean plants. The plant by the window grew much taller than the one in the dark.

script.speaker: Mrs Hart
script.text: The prize is a book about space and a ticket to the science museum. The judges liked his clear drawings most of all.

script.speaker: Mrs Hart
script.text: Thank you all. Please take your projects home before five o'clock.
